title: Throughput Sherpa: end-to-end benchmarking harness and customer acceptance lab for Dedicated
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a reusable, customer-facing benchmarking harness ("Sherpa") that emulates realistic tenant mixes and verifies Dedicated capacity throughput guarantees, autoscaling behavior, and fleet control fallbacks. The harness must produce reproducible performance profiles, a formal benchmarking methodology, and a set of customer acceptance tests customers can run with their traffic templates. Output must feed into the Console dashboards and the onboarding playbook.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run mixed workloads with adjustable QPS, payload distributions, and KV cache-hit settings
Report includes P50/P95/P99 latency, sustained throughput, and cost-per-token estimates for each run
Autoscaler scenarios (scale-up, scale-down, thrashing protection) validated against target SLOs in controlled lab
Runbook and customer acceptance checklist published in Confluence with example commands and expected baselines
Artifacts (scripts, templates, dashboards) uploaded to GitHub and linked from Console onboarding flow
deliverables: benchmarking methodology doc: workloads, warmup, variance handling, and statistical reporting
customer-acceptance test suite with sample manifests for common customer profiles
Console integration: per-run artifact links and ingestion of metrics into runtime-ops dashboards
Runbook for SRE and Solutions Engineering to execute acceptance and sign-off
test_scenarios: Tenant-aware mix: 70% short-chat, 20% long-generation, 10% embeddings — ramp to sustain for 45 minutes
KV-cache warmup variant: cold-start versus warmed cache comparison across identical traffic
Autoscaler ramp: stepwise increase of QPS to trigger autoscaling events, validate target latency bounds
Fallback & degradation: force model-variant fallback and region failover while sustaining minimal throughput
Noisy neighbor simulation: inject bursty tenants to test QoS and tenant-aware scheduling
tasks: Design workload templates with Solutions Eng and two pilot customers
Implement driver abstractions for chat/generation/embedding workloads
Add KV cache simulation hooks and cold/warm run modes
Create Confluence benchmarking methodology and runbook
Partner with Console team for per-run links and ingestion
Validate against three internal Dedicated clusters and record baselines
Coordinate customer pilot runs and collect feedback
